Agentic Reasoning with Tool-Augmented Language Models

Abstract

We present a planner that reasons with α tool calls and revises each step.

1 Introduction

Agents that call tools need a plan, a memory and a way to recover from errors.

We evaluate on three benchmarks and report the average success rate across five seeds.
